qa_pairs.instruction: Why does the SCIM driver have only a limited set of unique properties compared to other drivers?
qa_pairs.output: The SCIM driver has only a limited set of unique properties because its only distinct configuration elements are the Driver Configuration and Global Configuration Values properties; all other driver properties such as Named Password, Engine Control Values, and Log Level are shared across all drivers in NetIQ Identity Manager.

qa_pairs.instruction: Which configuration properties are unique to the SCIM driver?
qa_pairs.output: The unique configuration properties for the SCIM driver are the Driver Configuration properties and the Global Configuration Values (GCV) properties. Every other driver property (e.g., Named Password, Engine Control Values, Log Level) is common to all drivers.

qa_pairs.instruction: How do you locate the documentation for the unique properties of the SCIM driver?
qa_pairs.output: To locate the documentation for the unique properties of the SCIM driver, open the NetIQ Identity Manager Driver Administration Guide and follow the link titled "Driver Properties" (path: ../../../identity-manager-48/driver_admin/data/b94pq23.html#b94pq23). This section contains the Driver Configuration and Global Configuration Values properties specific to the SCIM driver.

qa_pairs.instruction: Summarize the key points about driver properties for the SCIM driver.
qa_pairs.output: The SCIM driver’s only unique properties are its Driver Configuration and Global Configuration Values. All other driver settings—such as Named Password, Engine Control Values, and Log Level—are standard across every NetIQ Identity Manager driver.
